baseline.productVersion: version not verified; manual contents only

engine: JavaScript RegExp of the Electron runtime (V8); the exact version is shown in the workbench

topics.title: Guided and raw regex construction
topics.reason: Raw pattern editor plus a grouped token palette that inserts at the cursor and wraps the selection for group tokens.
topics.evidence: tests/regex.test.mjs explanation tests; Playwright build screenshot

topics.title: Literals, escaped, control, hex and octal characters
topics.reason: Parsed and explained, including \xHH, \uHHHH, \cX, \0 and legacy octal without u.

topics.title: Unicode code points and properties
topics.reason: \u{...}, \p{...} and \P{...} with u or v; tokens explain why they need the flag when it is off.

topics.title: Shorthand and custom character classes
topics.reason: Sets, negated sets, ranges and shorthands are parsed into the tree with per-range explanations.
topics.evidence: tests/regex.test.mjs explains anchors, classes and quantifiers

topics.title: POSIX bracket classes
topics.reason: The JavaScript engine has no [[:alpha:]] classes. Conversion to POSIX ERE writes them for \d \w \s.

topics.title: Class intersection and subtraction
topics.reason: Supported with the v flag (&&, --, nested classes, \q{...}) and executed by the engine; explanation is per operator.

topics.title: Anchors and word boundaries
topics.reason: ^, $ (with m), \b and \B are explained and traced through the engine.

topics.title: Capturing, named and non-capturing groups and alternation
topics.reason: Numbered and named groups, non-capturing groups and alternation are built, explained, highlighted and traced.

topics.title: Atomic groups
topics.reason: The JavaScript engine has no atomic groups; the token is shown disabled with the emulation (?=(...))\1.

topics.title: Greedy and lazy quantifiers
topics.reason: *, +, ?, {n}, {n,}, {n,m} and lazy forms are inserted, explained and traced with backtracking.

topics.title: Possessive quantifiers
topics.reason: The JavaScript engine has no possessive quantifiers; shown disabled with the reason.

topics.title: Lookahead and lookbehind
topics.reason: All four lookarounds are built and explained; lookahead is traced step by step, lookbehind as one engine-decided step.
topics.evidence: tests/regex.test.mjs lookaround explanation and trace tests

topics.title: Numbered and named backreferences
topics.reason: \1 and \k<name> are explained, diagnosed when the group is undefined or unfinished, and traced with case folding through the engine.

topics.title: Recursion, subroutines and balancing groups
topics.reason: The JavaScript engine has none of these; tokens are disabled with the exact reason.

topics.title: Conditionals
topics.reason: The JavaScript engine has no conditionals; token disabled with the reason.

topics.title: Mode modifiers
topics.reason: Modifier groups (?i:...) are parsed and explained; the token is enabled only when this engine version supports them, and the tracer treats them as one engine step.
topics.evidence: Depends on the Electron V8 version

topics.title: Comments and free-spacing mode
topics.reason: The JavaScript engine has no (?#...) comments or x flag.

topics.title: Regex options (flags)
topics.reason: d g i m s u v y toggles, each described, u and v mutually exclusive, unsupported flags disabled per engine probe.

topics.title: Replacement text references and explanation
topics.reason: $n, $nn, $<name>, $&, $`, $' and $$ are parsed and explained independently of the regex.

topics.title: Replacement conditionals and case conversion
topics.reason: JavaScript replacement strings have no conditionals or case conversion; a replacement function would be needed.

topics.title: Plain-English explanation tree
topics.reason: Nested explanation with merged literal runs, quantifier wording, flag-aware text and Unicode names.

topics.title: Selection sync between pattern and tree
topics.reason: Selecting a tree line selects that span in the pattern; moving the cursor marks the deepest tree line.

topics.title: Tips and diagnostics
topics.reason: Engine errors, nested repetition risk, overlapping alternatives, empty repetition, undefined or unfinished backreferences, surrogate pairs without u.

topics.title: Adjustable explanation precision
topics.reason: One level of detail is offered; a terse/verbose switch is not built yet.
topics.evidence: Next: add a detail level control

topics.title: Export the explanation
topics.reason: Copy as text, save as Markdown, HTML or JSON (with diagnostics and engine).

topics.title: Editing the pattern through the tree
topics.reason: The tree selects source spans but cannot edit nodes directly yet.

topics.title: Application and flavour selection
topics.reason: The only executed flavour is this JavaScript engine (version shown). Other flavours are selectable as static notes and conversion targets only.

topics.title: Compare flavours
topics.reason: Feature matrix for features the pattern uses across PCRE2, Python re, .NET, Java, Go and POSIX ERE, labelled static notes reviewed 2026-11-20; nothing is executed in those engines.
topics.evidence: tests/regex.test.mjs compare marks only JavaScript as executed

topics.title: Convert to another flavour
topics.reason: Previewed conversion with change list and blockers; the original is kept; the result is not verified in the target engine.

topics.title: Match highlighting and navigation
topics.reason: All matches highlighted with previous/next navigation and counts, run in the worker.

topics.title: Capture group table and unmatched groups
topics.reason: Each match lists every group with positions from the engine (d flag) and "did not take part" for unmatched groups; groups are tinted in the subject.

topics.title: Replace preview
topics.reason: Engine result plus per-match pieces verified against it; applying to the test subject needs the two-key confirmation and can be undone; no other data is touched.

topics.title: Split
topics.reason: Engine split with optional limit, capture groups included, parts listed and copyable.

topics.title: Expected outcome test cases
topics.reason: Must match / must not match cases with pass and fail, saved with library entries and exports.

topics.title: Hex view, encodings and line endings
topics.reason: Code point, UTF-8 and UTF-16 view of the selected match and line ending counts; no full hex editor or encoding conversion of the subject.
topics.evidence: Next: hex subject view and encoding picker

topics.title: File and clipboard input and output
topics.reason: A text file can be loaded as the subject (read only); results can be copied. Saving a replaced file is not offered.
topics.evidence: Next: save replaced copy to a new file

topics.title: Line and page scopes
topics.reason: Testing always runs on the whole subject; per-line scope is not built.

topics.title: Step trace of a match attempt
topics.reason: Backtracking walk where every atom, class and anchor is decided by the engine, compared with the engine match; disagreement is shown, never hidden.
topics.evidence: tests/regex.test.mjs trace agrees with the engine

topics.title: Backtracking and zero-width steps
topics.reason: Steps show try, match, fail, backtrack, repeat and capture, including zero-width assertions and empty repetition stops; selecting a step marks pattern span and subject position.
topics.evidence: tests/regex.test.mjs step limit test; Playwright debug screenshot

topics.title: Tracing inside lookbehind and modifier groups
topics.reason: Decided by the engine as one step with an explicit note; inner steps are not traced.

topics.title: Compare pattern speed
topics.reason: Up to three patterns timed on a matching and a non-matching subject in the worker within a time budget, with relative bars.

topics.title: Growth with input length
topics.reason: Measures time as the input grows, streams partial results, stops at the budget and names exponential growth.

topics.title: Generate code snippets
topics.reason: JavaScript, Python, C#, Java, Go and PHP for first match, all matches, replace and split, with language-correct string escaping and conversion notes; only JavaScript shares this engine.

topics.title: Editable source templates
topics.reason: Templates are built in and not editable yet.

topics.title: Copy and paste with escaping
topics.reason: Copy as a JavaScript literal or JSON and escape a selection as a literal; pasting from other languages is not unescaped automatically.

topics.title: Saved regex collection
topics.reason: Local library with name, description, pattern, flags, replacement and tests; built-in examples; search through its own anchored builder; delete with confirmation.

topics.title: Parameterised reuse
topics.reason: %name% placeholders filled when used; values are escaped unless marked as regex; the result is validated before use.

topics.title: Search pasted text and picked files
topics.reason: Read-only search over pasted text and user-picked files with size, count and result limits, binary skip, file:line:column results, recent searches and export.

topics.title: Folders, masks and recursion
topics.reason: The renderer has no file system access; folder walking with masks needs a main-process route that is not built.
topics.evidence: Next: main-process folder reader with masks

topics.title: Replace in files with backups
topics.reason: This tool only reads files; replacing in files with verified backups and restore is not built.
topics.evidence: Next: main-process replace with backup and restore proof

topics.title: Multiple experiments and history
topics.reason: Separate sessions per search field and the standalone workbench, plus a recall history that is memory-only unless kept on the device by choice.

topics.title: Export and import
topics.reason: Session and library export as JSON, subject excluded unless chosen; imports are validated and previewed before they are added.

topics.title: External tool integration
topics.reason: No launch-and-return integration with other editors exists.
topics.evidence: Next: decide on a supported route

topics.title: Command line and automation
topics.reason: No command line or automation interface for the workbench yet.

topics.title: Contextual help
topics.reason: Every token, flag and disabled feature carries its own explanation; there is no separate help pane.
topics.evidence: Next: help pane bound to the selected node

topics.title: Keyboard editing and shortcuts
topics.reason: All controls are keyboard reachable; section tabs use arrow keys, Home and End; Ctrl+Enter reruns; Escape returns from the field builder to its search.

topics.title: Preferences and workspace layout
topics.reason: Layout follows the app theme and narrow widths; panels cannot be rearranged and there are no regex-specific preferences beyond history keeping.

topics.title: Anchored builder beside every search field
topics.reason: Every MVL.makeSearch field has its own builder with flags, tokens, explanation, risk gate, history, snippets and an Open in workbench link that returns the result to that field only. Fields that do not use makeSearch are outside this lane.

topics.title: Adversarial patterns cannot freeze the interface
topics.reason: All workbench runs happen in a Web Worker that is terminated when it passes its budget; field searches refuse risky patterns until allowed and then cut each item to 2,000 characters.
